world.title: 神经网络通过调整权重学习分类
world.posterTitle: 神经网络用误差反向调整权重
world.posterHook: 换数据集、加深网络、改学习率——看决策边界怎样一点点贴上数据。
world.posterSource: 纯 JavaScript 反向传播 · 本地构建
world.question: 神经网络是怎样从数据中学会分类的？
world.hook: 在这个迷你 TensorFlow Playground 里，你可以选数据集、改网络结构、调超参数，然后看损失下降、决策边界成形。
world.payoff: 神经网络通过反向传播不断调整权重，把复杂边界一点点逼近真实数据；层数和神经元越多，表达能力越强，但也需要更合适的激活函数和学习率。

en.title: A neural network learns classification by adjusting weights
en.posterTitle: A neural network uses error to update its weights
en.posterHook: Swap datasets, deepen the net, change the learning rate — watch the decision boundary ease onto the data.
en.question: How do neural networks learn to classify from data?
en.hook: In this mini TensorFlow Playground, you can select the data set, change the network structure, adjust the hyperparameters, and then watch the loss decrease and the decision boundary take shape.
en.payoff: Neural networks continuously adjust weights through backpropagation to bring complex boundaries closer to real data; the more layers and neurons, the stronger the expression ability, but more appropriate activation functions and learning rates are also required.
